mechanism: Predict unchanged hourly averages with hourly anchor + beta_h*(last observed 10min power - hourly anchor). Fit two independent beta_h by through-origin least squares on the available original-training prefix, clipped to[0,1], no intercept and no hyperparameter search. Inference does not access query targets.
data_contract: Same hourly targets, seven-channel history, input72/h2/stride3, six turbines, scaler and exact evaluation windows. Explicitly ADD one causal within-hour power statistic: source tick issue-10min, availability conservatively source timestamp+10min. Reconstruct all six ticks of its observed hour and compare to unchanged anchor within1e-8kW; mismatch/missing tick stops, never filters evaluation samples. No source tick from target hour.
training_evidence: A training-only raw reconstruction agrees within4.55e-13kW. Prefix-fitted end-state coefficients jointly reduce MAE/RMSE on all three later training query blocks: MAE gains10.868/9.531/5.786kW and RMSE15.684/12.991/8.028kW. This is development evidence used to design the mechanism, NOT independent confirmation. Fixed beta=1 fails late block, so do not blindly replace anchor with last10min value.
partition: Existing v12 three chronological expanding training origins70/80/90%, purged targets, all fitting outcomes available by first query issue. Same algorithm across origins, no query labels fit coefficients. Only if it passes all three origins, fit the same two coefficients once on all original outer-train and then freeze before any outer prediction.
selection: Existing select_rolling: jointly MAE/RMSE non-worse than Persistence in all3 origins within1e-8 and mean error ratio<1-1e-8. One declared learned candidate only; otherwise exact Persistence. Fixed beta=1 is a read-only diagnostic ablation, never an alternative candidate chosen from outer results.
comparisons: Persistence is the exact zero-increment information ablation. Also report fixed last10min anchor. Historical neural models lack this extra causal observation and use different fitting budgets: any gain demonstrates input-information utility, NOT architecture/Wiki superiority or tuned-SOTA dominance.
budget: Three two-scalar fits on original training origins; at most one final full-train two-scalar fit. No neural retraining, extra seed, fold, threshold or candidate search. Completed fits and reports strictly reused by protocol/code/data/input/output hashes.
primary_success: Outer MAE and RMSE both improve vs exact Persistence and frozen original base. Report lead-specific errors, paired block intervals/Newey-West, capacity tolerance hits. Not independent confirmation: outer period has previously been inspected.
resource_policy: CPU only; own BLAS/OpenMP2threads, never initialize CUDA or signal/throttle another user. No duplicate numeric suite.
